Can I walk through a forest and not interpret its history? I've been asked that question a number of times, suggesting that the need to analyze forest histories may be something that I can't control. My wife, Marcia, and I live on 35 acres in Westminster, Vermont, the bulk of which is a woodlot that I manage to promote biodiversity, our cordwood supply, and some saw timber.
